description: This file contains a Java test class 'XBRLIntegrationTest' for integration testing of XBRL related functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup methods, a test case to retrieve taxonomy list, and verification logic, along with necessary imports and logging.

classes.name: XBRLIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that performs integration testing for XBRL taxonomy retrieval within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes REST assured configurations, sets up request and response specifications before each test.

methods.name: shouldRetrieveTaxonomyList
methods.description: Test method that retrieves a list of taxonomies using the helper class and verifies its content.

methods.name: verifyTaxonomyList
methods.description: Verifies that the first taxonomy in the list has the expected name, logs the process.
